title: Alignment Makes Language Models Normative, Not Descriptive

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting decision token probabilities from base and aligned models in interactive multi-round strategic games (bargaining, persuasion, negotiation, matrix games) and one-shot tasks, and comparing their Pearson correlations with actual empirical human choice distributions to demonstrate that aligned models over-predict socially endorsed (normative) behaviors rather than actual (descriptive) human behaviors.
